craft_notes: Sthāyin: contrast-joy (awake vs other). Close: end-contrast. Rejected: 'everlasting' — kept ever; merging the contrast — killed: but kept.

lines: His perception ever, in three states unfailing;
ever the fully awake's — but the other's, at beginning and end.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tasyopalabdhiḥ satataṃ tripadāvyabhicāriṇī | nityaṃ syāt suprabuddhasya tadādyante parasya tu

reads_against.argmap: His perception ever, unfailing in three states; ever may be of the fully awake — at beginning-end, but of the other.
c1_essence: Perception ever unfailing triple; fully awake's, beginning-end, but other's.
